question: Odissi classical dance originated in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Odissi** is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India and originated in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• It is deeply rooted in the traditions and temples of Odisha, particularly the **Jagannath Temple in Puri**.
 
• The dance form is characterized by its **graceful movements, sculpturesque poses, and intricate footwork**.
 
• Odissi primarily focuses on expressing religious stories and spirituality through **"abhinaya" (expression) and "nritya" (pure dance)**.
 
• It is believed to have been performed as a form of devotion and offering in Odisha's temples since ancient times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classical Dance Forms of India:**

 
 
• India officially recognizes **eight classical dance forms**, including Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, and Sattriya.
 
• These dance forms are rooted in the **Natya Shastra**, an ancient Sanskrit text on performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Odissi Costume:**
 
 
• The dancers wear traditional attire made of silk with intricate designs inspired by temple sculptures.
 
• The jewelry includes silver ornaments, and the makeup emphasizes eye expressions (kohl-lined eyes).
 
 
 
• **Key Elements of Odissi:**
 
 
• It has two main components: **Nritya** (expressive dance) and **Nritta** (pure dance).
 
• Signature poses include the ** and chowk** (square stance).
 
 
 
• **Revival of Odissi:**
 
 
• Odissi faced decline during colonial rule but was revived in the mid-20th century by prominent dancers and scholars.
 
• Notable contributors include **Kelucharan Mohapatra** and **Guru Pankaj Charan Das**.
